verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a Transfers v3 API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, which replaces the legacy Quote API. Fiat and crypto wallets can be managed via Portal or API, and there are flows to use a fiat balance to send stablecoins, fund in stablecoins and pay out fiat, and auto-route fiat virtual account deposits to crypto addresses. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard/Portal support for conversions (only wallet management is shown there), detailed end-to-end internal transfer and rebalancing docs beyond the migration guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
